stories.headline: Prabowo fires financial regulators after market plunge and MSCI warnings
stories.summary: President Prabowo ordered the firing of financial regulators following Indonesia's stock market plunge in late January and unheeded warnings from MSCI about market transparency concerns. The president was reportedly furious over the market turmoil and threats to the country's reputation.
